data.name: StartupWindowHint
data.value:
On automatic startup, hide the main window in the system tray. An enabled floating window still appears.
Turn this off to show the main window. Manual launches are unaffected.

data.name: WindowsControlNotice
data.value: Windows startup app settings still apply. If Windows has disabled startup, check your Windows settings.

data.name: BackgroundNoticeHint
data.value: Shows “CodexMonitor is still running in the system tray” at most once per session.

data.name: FailureNoticeHint
data.value: Shows a brief reason for the failure. Details are recorded in the log.

data.name: RefreshIntervalHint
data.value:
Fetch quota data automatically every 1–60 minutes. Saving restarts the interval.
Manual refresh does not have to wait for this interval; it is unavailable while a refresh is in progress.

data.name: DragHint
data.value:
When unlocked, drag an empty area to move the floating window.
When locked, it stays on top and mouse clicks pass through. Unlock it from the tray menu or Settings.
